description: This file contains utility functions for making API requests, including GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, and RTK Query endpoints, for a web application related to user profiles, challenges, exams, donations, and certificates.

methods.name: getCSRFToken
methods.description: Retrieves CSRF token from cookies if in browser environment.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified API path with CSRF token header.

methods.name: combineDataWithResponse
methods.description: Combines fetch response with parsed JSON data.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the API.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs a PUT request to the API.

methods.name: deleteRequest
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to the API.

methods.name: parseApiResponseToClientUser
methods.description: Converts API user response data into client User object.

methods.name: mapFilesToChallengeFiles
methods.description: Maps API challenge files to client challenge files format.

methods.name: mapKeyToFileKey
methods.description: Converts array of files with 'key' to 'fileKey'.

methods.name: getUserProfile
methods.description: Fetches public profile data for a given username.

methods.name: getShowCert
methods.description: Fetches certificate details for a user.

methods.name: getGenerateExam
methods.description: Fetches data to generate an exam.

methods.name: postChargeStripeCard
methods.description: Charges via Stripe with card info.

methods.name: postMsUsername
methods.description: Associates a Microsoft transcript URL with username.

methods.name: examAttempts
methods.description: RTK Query API for exam attempts.

methods.name: examEnvironmentAuthorizationTokenApi
methods.description: RTK Query API for exam environment tokens.
